description: Reads the open comments on one Notion page or block. Each comment is reduced to id, discussion_id (comments in one thread share it), created_time, created_by (a name, or an id when Notion gives no name), text and parent. Resolved comments are not returned by Notion's API. The result is {results, has_more, next_cursor}, with the same shape when there are no results. has_more true means more results exist than this page holds, and next_cursor is the cursor argument that returns them.

account.description: Optional email address of the connected account to use (e.g. 'user@gmail.com'). If omitted, the default account is used.

block_id.description: The page or block's Notion id, with or without dashes, or a Notion URL that contains it (the id is read from the URL).

cursor.description: The next_cursor value from an earlier call with the same arguments. Returns the page of results after that one. Absent for the start of the list.

page_size.description: How many results one call returns, from 1 to 100. Default 50. A full page comes back with has_more true and a next_cursor for the rest.

name: notion-mcp__notion_get_comments
